fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { officeSwaps: "Build a cookie exchange sign up sheet for my office holiday swap. List 14 cookie types and let each coworker claim one with their name. Once a cookie is claimed, take it off the list so the next person only sees what is still open, and show me who is bringing what.", neighborhoodSwaps: "Build a sign up sheet for my street's cookie swap. Cap it at 12 households and ask for a name, an email, and the cookie they will bake. Each baker brings 6 cookies for every household on the list. When the 12th household signs up, close the sheet and email every baker how many dozen to bake and the Saturday drop-off at my garage.", scoutTroopSwaps: "Build a cookie exchange sign up sheet for my scout troop. Ask each family for their cookie and checkboxes for what the batch contains, including peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, and wheat. The night before the swap, email me a list of every batch that contains peanuts so I can put them on a separate table.", swapsByMail: "Build a sign up sheet for my book club's cookie swap by mail. Ask each member for their name, mailing address, and the cookie they will ship. Once all 16 members sign up, match each member with another and email them that person's address and a December 8 ship-by date. Show me every match on one page." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a cookie exchange sign up sheet for my office holiday swap where each baker claims a different cookie and lists its allergens.
